label: GB-dpa-2018 Section 161

obligations.text:
Approval of first guidance about regulatory action
(1)
When the first guidance is produced under section 160(1)—
(a)
the Commission must submit the final version to the Secretary of State, and
(b)
the Secretary of State must lay the guidance before Parliament.

(2)
If, within the 40-day period, either House of Parliament resolves not to approve the guidance—
(a)
the Commission must not issue the guidance, and
(b)
the Commission must produce another version of the guidance (and this section applies to that version).

(3)
If, within the 40-day period, no such resolution is made—
(a)
the Commission must issue the guidance, and
(b)
the guidance comes into force at the end of the period of 21 days beginning with the day on which it is issued.
